model_output.rationale: 271 confirms coverage inactive (EB*6) with eligibility end 2025-05-31, before the 2025-06-12 DOS. All four lines carry PR-27. Filing indicator is CI (commercial). PR group code on a commercial claim means patient may be billed after overrides are cleared. No QMB, Medicaid, NSA, or ACA grace-period indicator present. Hold-harmless reaches members for covered services — coverage ended before DOS, so patient is outside it. Bill patient.

root_cause.explanation: 271 shows EB*6 (inactive), eligibility end DTP*357 = 2025-05-31; DOS is 2025-06-12. Coverage had lapsed 12 days before service. All four lines denied PR-27.

next_action.detail: Send patient a statement for $181.22. Verify no QMB/Medicaid/NSA override applies. No appeal basis; payer's determination is consistent with the 271.

evidence.fact: EB*6 (inactive), DTP*357 (eligibility end) = 2025-05-31, plan date 2025-06-12 — coverage terminated before DOS.
All four lines adjusted PR-27 ($181.22 total patient responsibility); filing indicator CI; no OA or CO group code.
Subscriber relationship 18 (self), payer responsibility P (primary), no secondary payer on file.

citations.rule: CI + EB*6 + DTP*357 before DOS + PR-27 → bill_patient after overrides cleared
PR = patient liability; commercial CI hold-harmless does not extend to non-members on the DOS
